create_PI0ImageProcessor: create a PI0ImageProcessor with BICUBIC resizing, ImageNet normalization, and 224x224 padding for image preprocessing
resize_PI0ImageProcessor: resize images to 224x224 using BICUBIC interpolation with PI0ImageProcessor.do_resize and PI0ImageProcessor.resample
normalize_PI0ImageProcessor: normalize images using ImageNet standard mean and standard deviation via PI0ImageProcessor.image_mean and PI0ImageProcessor.image_std
pad_PI0ImageProcessor: pad images to 224x224 using PI0ImageProcessor.do_pad and PI0ImageProcessor.pad_size for uniform input dimensions
convert_rgb_PI0ImageProcessor: convert images to RGB format using PI0ImageProcessor.do_convert_rgb for consistent channel processing
